issue.title: Bug: [Chassis] interfaces-config.service fails on chassis during first boot if there is no config present

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

High

### Description of the bug

On a chassis system (o rmulti-asic), when the system boot first time without any migrated config present, there is no DEVICE_METADATA available. In such case, interfaces-config.service fails due to recently added check for DEVICE_METADTA in the interfaces-config.sh file for smartswitch. This prevents for any dhcp service from starting and the device is not reachable if the system depends on dhcp for initial IP config.
The code should check if DEVICE_METADAT is defined.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/blob/master/files/image_config/interfaces/interfaces.j2#L134

```

resolution.title: Fixed interfaces-config.service failure on chassis during first boot if there is no config present
resolution.description:
#### Why I did it
Fixes https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/22947

##### Work item tracking
- Microsoft ADO **(number only)**:

#### How I did it
Added check for DEVCIE_METADATA before using it.

#### How to verify it
1. Sonic-installer install a system without any config migration.
2. Just to validate the file:
sonic-cfggen -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/interfaces.j2

Without change:
```
sonic-cfggen -t /usr/share/sonic/templates/interfaces.j2
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-cfggen", line 517, in <module>
    main()
  File "/usr/local/bin/sonic-cfggen", line 481, in main
    template_data = template.render(data)
                    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/jinja2/environment.py", line 1301, in render
    self.environment.handle_exception()
  File "/usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/jinja2/environment.py", line 936, in handle_exception
    raise rewrite_traceback_stack(source=source)
  File "/usr/share/sonic/templates/interfaces.j2", line 31, in top-level template code
    {% block mgmt_interface %}
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/share/sonic/templates/interfaces.j2", line 134, in block 'mgmt_interface'

With change:
```

auto lo
iface lo inet loopback
   address <IP>
   netmask <IP>
   scope host
   post-up ip addr del <IP>/8 dev lo
   pre-down ip addr add <IP>/8 dev lo

# The management network interface
auto eth0
iface eth0 inet dhcp
    metric 202
iface eth0 inet6 dhcp
    up sysctl net.ipv6.conf.eth0.accept_ra=1
    down sysctl net.ipv6.conf.eth0.accept_ra=0
#
source /etc/network/interfaces.d/*
#
```
